summary: Completed frontend testing of email composer feature across ContactsPage, SellerLeadsPage, and PropertyLeadsPage. Also tested Signature Settings page. All features working correctly.
passed_tests: ContactsPage: Email icon visible on contact cards with email addresses
ContactsPage: Email modal opens when clicking email icon
ContactsPage: Modal shows recipient name and email
ContactsPage: Subject input field present and functional
ContactsPage: Message textarea present and functional
ContactsPage: Signature preview section displays user's signature
ContactsPage: 'Open in Email Client' button present
SellerLeadsPage: Email icon visible on leads with email addresses
SellerLeadsPage: Email modal opens when clicking email icon
SellerLeadsPage: Modal shows recipient name and email
SellerLeadsPage: Signature preview section displays user's signature
SellerLeadsPage: 'Open in Email Client' button present
PropertyLeadsPage: Page loads correctly (9 property leads)
PropertyLeadsPage: Email icon correctly hidden when leads have no owner_email (0 with owner info)
SignatureSettings: Page accessible via Settings > Profile > Email Signature
SignatureSettings: All form fields present (Name, Title, Phone, Email, Company, Website, Custom HTML)
SignatureSettings: Save Signature button works - shows success toast
SignatureSettings: Updated signature reflects in email composer modal

features_verified.email_composer_contacts: Working - modal opens with recipient info, subject, message, signature preview, and 'Open in Email Client' button
features_verified.email_composer_property_leads: Working - email icon only shows when lead has owner_email (currently 0 leads have owner info)
features_verified.signature_settings: Working - can view, edit, and save signature settings
features_verified.signature_fetch: Working - signature is fetched from /api/users/me/signature and displayed in email composer
features_verified.signature_save: Working - signature saves to backend and updates are reflected in email composer

context_for_next_testing_agent: Email composer feature is fully functional on ContactsPage and SellerLeadsPage. PropertyLeadsPage email icon only appears when leads have owner_email set (currently 0 leads have owner info). Signature Settings page at /settings under Profile > Email Signature allows users to configure their email signature which is automatically appended to emails. The signature is fetched from /api/users/me/signature endpoint.

email_composer_ui_elements.recipient_info_box: Shows recipient name and email in muted background box
email_composer_ui_elements.signature_preview: Dashed border box showing 'Your signature will be added:' with signature details
email_composer_ui_elements.action_buttons: Cancel (outline) and 'Open in Email Client' (blue, with Send icon)

signature_settings_fields.title_position: Input with placeholder 'Senior Real Estate Agent'
signature_settings_fields.custom_html: Textarea for optional custom HTML signature
